checks.label: Equations that have more than one unknown can have an infinite number of solutions: every receipt, order, reading and fact here accepts at least three guesses on its grid, and every guess it accepts lies on its one straight line

A solution of a system of two equations is an ordered pair that makes both equations true: in every two-fact story here exactly one guess on the grid passes both facts, and it is where their two lines cross
When the two equations were really the same line, there were infinitely many solutions: receipt 3 at £16 accepts exactly the guesses receipt 1 accepts, and its line lies on top of receipt 1's
If the lines are parallel (and therefore do not intersect), there is no solution: at £15 receipt 3's line runs alongside receipt 1's without meeting it, and no guess on the grid passes both

Every worked line is right, by hand: p = 8 − 2d swapped in gives d + 16 − 4d = 7, −3d = −9, d = 3 and p = 2; 10y = 8 gives 80p and £1.20 a metre; 4w = 16 and a £3.50 socket; 200a = 20 gives P = 0.1W + 5; 300a = 24 gives a = 0.08 and b = 10; 2x = 24 gives 12 m and 18 m; 2c = 6 gives £3 and £1.75; and 35 N at 250 N

Every puzzle has three answers, one of them right, and a hint of its own for each wrong one; the right pair passes both facts, each wrong pair fails at least one, and only the right second receipt crosses receipt 1

Before an answer a puzzle keeps back the crossing ring and the working; a right answer or Why? draws both lines, rings the crossing, moves the guess there so both cards match, and works it through; a wrong pair is tried in every card and fails one

The first screen opens with a £2 drink and £4 popcorn on receipt 1, where 2 × 2 + 4 = 8 matches; its demonstration leaves marks at (£2, £4), (£3, £2) and (£1, £6) and only then draws the line through them

On the doubled-receipt screen receipt 3 at £16 accepts a £1 drink and £6 popcorn and its line lies on receipt 1's; at £15 the same guess comes to too much, its line moves off to run alongside, and no ring appears
Every demonstration settles within its 3 to 5 s, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends, and a puzzle's answer, Why? or wrong pick settles within 2.5 s
